title: Highlander Silver Showcases Key Development Milestones in Corani Photo Update
summary: Toronto, July 7, 2026 – Highlander Silver Corp. (TSX, NYSE American: HSLV) (“Highlander Silver” or the “Company”) is pleased to provide a photo update showcasing key milestones achieved in the site development of its Corani Silver Project in Peru.
body_markdown: Toronto, June 25, 2026 – Highlander Silver Corp. (TSX, NYSE American: HSLV) (“Highlander Silver” or the “Company”) is pleased to report on a comprehensive geophysical study of the Corani Silver Project integrating historical datasets with the first airborne magnetic survey and more extensive induced polarization-resistivity surveys than historically undertaken.
